description: This file defines the LightyTest package, a Perl module for testing the Lighttpd web server. It includes methods for managing test server processes, performing HTTP requests, and checking server features, primarily used in automated test suites for the server.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A Perl class for managing and executing tests on the Lighttpd server, including process control, server feature detection, and HTTP request handling.

methods.name: mtime
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a given file.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for the LightyTest class, initializes server paths and environment settings.

methods.name: listening_on
methods.description: Checks if the server is listening on a specified port.

methods.name: stop_proc
methods.description: Terminates the server process if it is running.

methods.name: wait_for_port_with_proc
methods.description: Waits until the server is listening on a given port, with a timeout.

methods.name: bind_ephemeral_tcp_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket to an ephemeral port.

methods.name: get_ephemeral_tcp_port
methods.description: Returns an available ephemeral port number.

methods.name: cygpath_alm
methods.description: Converts a Windows path to Cygwin or MSYS format.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the Lighttpd server as a subprocess, with configuration for different environments.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the server and verifies the response.

methods.name: spawnfcgi
methods.description: Launches a FastCGI application as a subprocess.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server build supports a specific feature.

methods.name: has_crypto
methods.description: Checks if the server build supports cryptography.
